experiment: Quick method-vs-environment test: same Cal-QL calibrated Q-max fine-tune from a WEAKER init (P0 well below the v11 strong init), plus a teacher ceiling probe
question: The Cal-QL/Qmax arms plateau ~0.91 and never exceed the 0.944 teacher. Is that a METHOD problem (fine-tuning cannot improve / exceeds nothing) or an ENVIRONMENT problem (0.944 ~ ceiling, no room)?
weak_init_generation: Short v11-style OFFLINE distillations (same config/hyperparams as v11, expert fraction 1.0, expectile 0.9, low BC budget). KEY FINDING: IQLD distillation saturates almost instantly - 60ep/bc800 formal 0.900/0.902, 150ep/bc1500 formal 0.906/0.908, full 2000ep v11 0.918/0.910. There is no easy way to make a much weaker init by shortening distillation; all IQLD distills of this teacher land ~0.90-0.92.

teacher_ceiling_probe.setup: 700 nominal episodes (seeds 101..), game-theory teacher, classify every miss
teacher_ceiling_probe.reading: When the teacher loses, the goal-directed evader (private goal + potential field, 0.50 vs 0.45 m/s speed advantage) reaches its goal cleanly; the teacher NEVER had it enclosed near capture and lost it. 0.944 ~ environment ceiling for closed-loop pursuit; there is essentially no near-miss margin to harvest with sharper play.

conclusion.verdict: Mostly ENVIRONMENT, with a small secondary METHOD-side distill gap
conclusion.environment: Teacher failures are 98% decisive evader goal-reaches, 0% near-misses over 700 episodes -> ~0.94 is the effective ceiling for this 3v1 contract-v2 task; exceeding the 0.944 teacher with ANY method is close to impossible by construction (uncatchable episodes, not unlucky margins).
conclusion.method: IQLD distillation saturates at ~0.90-0.92 (60ep already 0.900); a persistent ~2-4pp distill loss to the teacher's own closed-loop play exists but calibrated online fine-tuning cannot close it - from a weak start (0.906) it drifts DOWN slightly (best_safe 0.894/0.890, latest 0.886/0.870); from the strong start it holds ~0.91. No loss-level tweak found any headroom, consistent with the ceiling probe.
conclusion.what_would_help: Not better losses. Either task-design change (pursuer speed/count/capture radius advantage, non-private evader goal, larger arena) or genuinely new behavior data beyond the teacher's own - but given 0% near-miss the teacher data already covers what is capturable.
conclusion.note_minsep: robust minsep ~0.295 marginally below the 0.30 gate across ALL arms incl. teacher-era baselines: a separate safety-margin calibration issue, unchanged by these experiments.
